entries.title: Verify the published scope and technical limits of bad_query
entries.claim: The upstream project documents a sandbox-escape proof of concept whose stated OS range overlaps iOS 26.6.1.
entries.expected_observation: Primary source code and documentation identify the mechanism, prerequisites, limitations, and exact supported builds.
entries.falsifying_observation: The source does not support the stated version range, prerequisites are unmet, or no verifiable technical evidence backs the claim.
prerequisites: Review source and license without executing the project
Separate documentation claims from behavior established by code
entries.status: source review completed; exact-target verification blocked
review_findings: README claims iOS 26.0–26.6.1 / iOS 27.0 beta 4 support, but does not identify an exact tested build for iPhone 16 Plus identifier iPhone17,4 / build 23G83.
README explicitly calls the project a developer proof-of-concept and says it is not meaningfully usable.
Documented scope is selected container/data paths; this alone does not demonstrate kernel privilege escalation, persistence, package manager support, or a full jailbreak.

Source confirms the general implementation approach, but this static review does not establish successful execution, a kernel primitive, privilege escalation, persistence, or full jailbreak capability.
entries.next_action: Keep exact_target_verified false. Seek upstream documented device/build test evidence and compare prerequisites/version-specific behavior; do not execute the PoC on the daily-use phone.

findings: Uses dlopen/dlsym to resolve private container-manager and sandbox-extension APIs.
Builds a container query and sets a path component containing parent-directory traversal.
Requests a sandbox token, then attempts to consume the returned extension; failure paths include query failure and kernel refusal.
Implementation contains OS-specific container classes and flags, so claimed version range alone cannot establish compatibility with the exact device build.

entries.title: Determine which customizations Erosion actually permits
entries.claim: Erosion documents limited customization capabilities on some iOS 26 versions.
entries.expected_observation: Source review identifies the features, required privileges, signing/distribution model, and device/version limitations.
entries.falsifying_observation: The feature list cannot be traced to code or its prerequisites exclude the target.
prerequisites: Review source, dependencies, license, and distribution method
Do not install or execute binaries during initial review
entries.status: source review completed; exact-target verification blocked
review_findings: README describes a customization toolbox that depends on bad_query; the documented scope is not equivalent to a full jailbreak.
README reports limitations on iOS 26, including unavailable MobileGestalt tweaks.
No independent reproduction on iPhone 16 Plus iPhone17,4 / iOS 26.6.1 build 23G83 was established by this source review.
No installation or execution was performed.
entries.next_action: Keep exact_target_verified false. Revisit only if upstream publishes exact-device/build evidence or a documented release materially changes target compatibility.

entries.title: Separate documented app-data access from full jailbreak capability
entries.claim: EscapeOS documents selected app-data browsing and backup behavior, which is narrower than a full jailbreak.
entries.expected_observation: Source review maps each user-visible operation to its required access and records the devices/builds explicitly tested upstream.
entries.falsifying_observation: The source does not substantiate the documented behavior or the target prerequisites differ materially.
prerequisites: Check whether host pairing or another computer is required
Do not assume a different iPhone/build test applies to iPhone17,4 / 23G83
entries.status: source review completed; exact-target verification blocked
review_findings: README describes app-container browsing and backup/restore rather than a complete jailbreak.
Documented initial setup requires a Windows host to prepare a pairing file, so the documented workflow is not iPhone-only.
Upstream mentions tests on a different device/build; that does not verify iPhone 16 Plus iPhone17,4 / iOS 26.6.1 build 23G83.
No installation or execution was performed.
entries.next_action: Keep exact_target_verified false. Treat as unsuitable for the current iPhone-only workflow unless upstream documents a supported no-host setup and exact-target evidence.

warning: These entries are research questions, not proof of exploitability or a working jailbreak.
